camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLiveMPUTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId yourTaskId --AppId yourAppId --ChannelId yourChannelId
description_en: Updates a stream mixing and relay task
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-mpu-task --app-id yourAppId --channel-id yourChannelId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveMPUTask

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can specify only one ID. The ID can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. You can specify only one ID. The ID can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can specify only one ID. The ID can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 55 characters in length. This ID is the identifier for the bypass relay and must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符。此ID为旁路转推的标识，需保证唯一
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream mixing mode. Valid values:
0: Single-stream relay. The original single stream is relayed without stream mixing and transcoding. You do not need to configure stream mixing and transcoding parameters.
1 (default): Stream mixing, transcoding, and relay
parameters.help_zh:
混流模式。取值：
0：单路转推，不混流转码，仅转推原始单路流，无需配置混流转码参数。
1（默认值）：混流转码转推
parameters.name: mix_mode

parameters.help_en:
The live stream ingest URL. Only the RTMP protocol is supported. You can specify only one URL, and the maximum length is 2,048 characters. For information about the generation rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html.
For domain names that have hotlink protection enabled, the ingest URL must include an access token.
The same StreamURL cannot be used in different tasks at the same time.
The same StreamURL cannot be used within 10 seconds after a task is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
直播推流地址，仅支持RTMP协议，仅支持传单个地址，最大长度不超过2048个字符。生成规则请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html。
对已开防盗链鉴权的域名，需要在推流地址中包含鉴权串。
禁止同一个StreamURL在不同任务中同时使用。
任务停止10S之内，禁止使用同一个StreamURL
parameters.name: stream_url

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to relay the stream to Alibaba Cloud CDN. Valid values:
false: The stream is relayed to a CDN other than Alibaba Cloud CDN.
true: The stream is relayed to Alibaba Cloud CDN.
The default value of this parameter is false
fields.help_zh:
是否转推到阿里云CDN。
false为转推非阿里云CDN。
true为转推阿里云CDN。
该参数默认为false
fields.name: is_ali_cdn

fields.help_en: The live stream ingest URL. Only the RTMP protocol is supported, and the maximum length is 2,048 characters. For information about the generation rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html

parameters.help_en: The multi-URL relay parameters. You can specify multiple live stream ingest URLs
parameters.help_zh: 多地址转推参数，可填写多个直播推流地址
parameters.name: multi_stream_url

camera (default): Camera.

单流转推模式下视频输入流类型，仅针对视频流（StreamType=2）有效。取值：

fields.name: background

fields.help_zh: 音频码率，取值范围：[8, 500]，单位：kbps

fields.help_en: The number of audio channels. Valid values: 1 and 2
fields.help_zh: 音频声道数，取值：1、2

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the stream is audio-only. Valid values:
true: Audio-only. You only need to configure audio-related parameters.
false (default): Not audio-only. All parameters except VideoCodec and EnhancedParam must be specified
fields.help_zh:
是否为纯音频，取值：
true：纯音频，仅需要设置音频相关参数。
false（默认值）：非纯音频，除VideoCodec参数与EnhancedParam参数外，其它参数均不能为空
fields.name: audio_only

fields.help_en: The audio sampling rate. Valid values: 8000, 16000, 32000, 44100, and 48000. Unit: Hz
fields.name: audio_sample_rate

fields.help_en:
The enhanced encoding parameters. The value is a JSON string. The supported optional configurations include profile and preset.
profile: The encoding level. If the video encoding format is H.264, valid values for profile are baseline, main, and high. If the video encoding format is H.265, the valid value for profile is main.
preset: The balance between encoding speed and quality. Valid values for preset are ultrafast, superfast, veryfast, faster, fast, medium, slow, slower, veryslow, and placebo. Each value represents a strategy for encoding speed and output video quality, ranging from ultrafast (fastest, prioritizing encoding speed) to placebo (pursuing ultimate quality, slowest encoding speed).

For example, superfast is mainly used in real-time communication. Do not configure this option unless you are a professional encoder technician
fields.help_zh:
编码增强参数，JSON字符串，目前支持的可选配置包括profile与preset。
profile：编码级别。当视频编码格式为H.264时，profile支持的可选值包括："baseline", "main", "high"；当视频编码格式为H.265时，profile支持的可选值包括："main"。

preset：调节编码速度和质量的平衡。preset支持的可选值包括："ultrafast", "superfast", "veryfast", "faster", "fast", "medium", "slow", "slower", "veryslow" "placebo"。每个值代表了一种编码速度与输出视频质量的策略，从"ultrafast"（极快，编码速度优先）到"placebo"（追求极致质量，编码极慢）。

例如设置superfast，主要用于实时通讯领域。建议非编码器专业技术人员，不设置该选项
fields.name: enhanced_param

fields.help_zh: 视频码率，取值范围：[1, 10000]，单位：kbps

fields.help_en:
The video encoding format. Valid values:
H.264 (default)
H.265
fields.help_zh:
视频编码格式。取值：

H.265

fields.help_zh: 视频GOP，取值范围：[1, 60]

The stream mixing user information corresponding to this pane. If this parameter is not specified, the backend automatically fills it based on the order in which upstream streamers join the channel.

If you specify the stream mixing user information, the user information must be configured in the TranscodeParams.UserInfos parameter.

该窗格对应的混流用户信息，不填时后台按照上行主播的进房顺序自动填充。

如果指定混流用户信息，该用户信息需要已在TranscodeParams.UserInfos参数中配置。
